jobs.title: Assistant / Associate Professor - Associate of Science in Nursing
jobs.description: Assistant/Associate Professor - ASN Assistant/Associate Professor - ASN Fort Wayne, Indiana Full-time Summary The position of Assistant/Associate Professor for the Associate of Science in Nursing program requires an individual who can provide excellence in teaching, interested in both their students and their subjects. The Assistant / Associate Professor must be committed to the centrality of a Trine University education. Reporting to the Director of Nursing of the ASN program in the Brooks College of Health Professions, the Assistant/Associate Professor should have a broad understanding of appropriate academic programs and potential future directions; be flexible, visionary, creative, and energetic; and want students to excel and take pleasure in their success. Fair discipline, attention to duty, and desire for self-improvement are expected traits of Trine University Faculty members. Duties and Responsibilities Specifically, the Assistant/Associate Professor will be responsible for the following duties: Instruction Teach a standard load of 18 contact hours per semester Provide excellence in teaching with adherence to University policies and protocol Post the course syllabus in the learning management system, Moodle, and review with students on the first day of class Record class attendance Submit absentee and deficiency information to Academic Support Services via MyPortal Assist students with academic deficiencies Post and maintain a regular schedule of at least ten (10) office hours per week Curriculum development and implementation Participate in the development, implementation, evaluation, and revision of instructional material and curricula within the ASN program Utilize the official syllabi of record (SoR) for each course taught Integrate best practices from Quality Matters into courses taught Adhere to the exam guidelines established by the ASN program Provide instruction for the class length listed in the official schedule Program contribution Collaborate with faculty and staff Adhere to the policies and procedures of the ASN program and nursing unit Participate in faculty committee meetings for the nursing unit Support student recruitment, admission, and retention for the ASN program in collaboration with the University enrollment staff Participate in advisory board meetings for the nursing unit Participate in the development of the nursing unit’s strategic plan Assist the ASN Director of Nursing in departmental functions Fiscal management of the program Provide input for the preparation and management of the annual budget Utilize the nursing unit’s resources responsibly to facilitate achievement of the mission, goals, core values, and expected outcomes Continuous programmatic review and analysis Engage in program evaluation with analysis of data to improve instructional and program quality Adherence to University goals, standards, and policies as well as nursing accreditation standards and policies Program accreditation processes Collaborate with the Executive Director of Nursing and the ASN Director of Nursing in the completion of required accreditation documents for the Indiana State Board of Nursing and national nursing accreditor(s) Participate in accreditation documentation and activities as required Perform additional duties and assignments as prescribed by the Executive Director of Nursing and the ASN Director of Nursing Required Education A Master of Nursing degree from an accredited university An earned doctorate degree in nursing, education, or a relevant discipline from an accredited university is preferred Holds an active, unencumbered registered nurse (RN) licence in the State of Indiana or in a Nursing Licensure Compact (NLC) state that includes practice privileges in Indiana. A minimum of three years’ experience in a full-time academic appointment with teaching responsibilities at the associate level is preferred A minimum of three years documented clinical experience as a registered nurse Documented scholarship (e.g., scholarship of application, scholarship of teaching, scholarship of integration, and scholarship of discovery) Salary Rank and salary will be based on qualifications. You may also request a physical copy by emailing IU Public Safety at iups@iu.edu Bookmark this Posting Print Preview | Apply for this Job Posting Details Position Details Title Assistant Clinical Professor in Physical Therapy Appointment Status Non-Tenure Track Department IU Indianapolis Department of Physical Therapy – School of Health & Human Sciences Location Indianapolis Position Summary The Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) Program in the Department of Graduate Health Professions, School of Health & Human Sciences (SHHS) at IU Indianapolis, invites applications for a Clinical Assistant Professor position. This is a full-time, non-tenure-track faculty appointment designed for individuals with strong clinical expertise and a passion for teaching and mentoring the next generation of physical therapists. The successful candidate will contribute to the program’s mission through excellence in teaching, student advising and mentorship, scholarship of teaching and learning, service to the university and PT profession, and professional engagement. PT faculty collaborates with colleagues in the Graduate Health Professions (Occupational Therapy, Nutrition and Dietetics, and Physician Assistants) to support student success, program development, and accreditation standards. Additionally, the successful applicant will serve on programs, school, and university committees. Faculty members have opportunities and support for scholarly activity and faculty development. Strong preference will be given to candidates with ABPTS specialist certification in the candidate’s primary practice area. We welcome candidates with clinical specialization in pediatrics, musculoskeletal, neurological, or geriatrics.Job Duties: 70% Teaching (9 credit hours per semester and scholarship) 30% Service Responsibilities: · Teach courses in the Physical Therapy Program.· Contribute to interdisciplinary initiatives and community engagement.· Mentor professional students.· Provide service at the departmental, school, and university levels.· Support learners through effective, evidence-based teaching practices. Applications will be reviewed beginning May 15, 2026, and will be accepted until the position is filled. The ideal target starting date is August 1, 2026.Interested candidates should review the application requirements and submit their letter of application, curriculum vitae, teaching statement, and the names and contact information for three references. The letter of intent should include a summary of qualifications and experience, key motivation for application, and a reflection on alignment with IU Indianapolis and SHHS’s mission and goals.IU Indianapolis is a leading urban research university located in downtown Indianapolis, serving more than 25,000 students across a wide range of programs. The campus includes over a dozen schools and academic units, offering degrees in fields such as business, engineering, health sciences, and the arts. A major highlight is its world-renowned Life Sciences campus, one of the largest in the country, where students learn alongside top medical professionals and researchers at facilities like hospitals, labs, and research centers. Through hands-on learning and strong community partnerships, IU Indianapolis prepares students to make a meaningful impact in their careers and in Indiana’s growing economy. IU Indianapolis has earned national recognition for its innovative health and life sciences initiatives, providing extensive opportunities for collaborative, interdisciplinary research. The university is making significant investments in research, including the launch of two new institutes: the Convergent Bioscience and Technology Institute (CBATI) and the Institute for Human Health and Wellbeing (H2W). Additionally, a $138 million grant from the Lilly Endowment will support the IU LAB, a state-of-the-art facility at the 16 Tech site designed to position Indiana as a national leader in bioscience discovery, commercialization, and talent development.SHHS provides undergraduate and graduate education in the areas of Kinesiology, Health Sciences, Tourism & Hospitality, and Sport Management. In addition, SHHS offers professional programs in Physical Therapy, Occupational Therapy, Nutrition and Dietetics, Physician’s Assistant, and a PhD in Human Performance & Rehabilitation Sciences.Indiana University seeks scholars who will contribute to our commitment to engaging the city, state, and broader communities through excellence in teaching, research, and service. Candidates should value the perspectives and experiences that shape our campus and surrounding communities as we prepare graduates to lead in an increasingly complex and interconnected world.Individuals who require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the search process must notify the School’s HR Business Partner, Myrna Palacios, at mypala@iu.edu, in advance. Basic Qualifications Candidates should have the following: · An earned Doctoral degree in Physical Therapy.· Licensure as a physical therapist in the State of Indiana.· A minimum of three (3) years of full-time post-licensure clinical practice experience· Strong commitment to teaching, scholarship of teaching and learning, and advising graduate students. Department Contact for Questions For more information on the position, please contact search committee chair Dr. Valerie Strunk at vstrunk@iu.edu. jobs.description: Assistant Dean for Academics Assistant Dean for Academics Angola, Indiana Full-time Summary Trine University invites applications for the position of Assistant Dean for Academics. This 12-month position supports the Vice President for Academic Affairs (VPAA) in advancing institutional priorities related to curriculum, academic policy, assessment, accreditation, and faculty development. The Assistant Dean for Academics must be committed to supporting Academic Affairs to meet Trine University’s mission through collaboration, thoughtful problem-solving, strong attention to detail, and the ability to guide complex academic initiatives to completion. It is recommended that the Assistant Dean for Academics have a history of effective teaching at the university level and experience with academic assessment, accreditation, curriculum management, and related academic affairs processes. The Assistant Dean for Academics should present evidence of strong leadership and interpersonal skills, the ability to build trust among collaborative university partners, and demonstrate the ability to manage multiple academic initiatives simultaneously. Duties and Responsibilities In addition, the Academic Dean for Academics must provide the following essential duties and responsibilities: Provide leadership, support, and guidance to university-wide academic assessment, accreditation processes, and continuous improvement efforts Provide leadership and quality assurance for academic policies, procedures, and the curriculum management process Provide leadership, support, and guidance to academic faculty committees and department chairs Provide support and guidance to the Registrar on academic process coordination Collaborate with the Student Success team on student support initiatives and student readmission and dismissal decisions Collaborate with the Business Office on academic-related requests and initiatives Collaborate with VPAA and Human Resources when applicable Serve as a direct report for applicable personnel within Academic Affairs Teach 3 credit hours per fall and spring semesters Supervise the Institutional Researcher & Reporter Collaborate with university departments on key processes and academic initiatives Other duties and assignments as identified by the VPAA Qualifications/Required Education An ideal candidate will have experience with assessment and/or accreditation. A doctoral degree is preferred, and candidates with master’s degrees will also be considered. Salary Rank and salary will be based on qualifications. Outstanding Benefits: Trine University offers a comprehensive benefit package designed to provide a variety of choices to best fit your needs and the needs of your family. Some benefits offered include: Health - medical, dental, flex spending, HSA accounts Life insurance - a variety of voluntary life options are available along with an employer paid employee life policy valued at 1 ½ times annual salary Paid vacation and sick time Retirement - after one year of full-time service you are eligible for an employer contribution of 5% and up to an additional 5% employer match Review of candidates will begin immediately and continue until position is filled. Faculty have strong potential to collaborate with: The Indiana Convention Center and Visit Indy NCAA and national governing sport bodies Professional sport franchises and event organizers Major recurring events (e.g., large-scale sporting championships, conventions, and festivals) Hospitality leaders, venue operators, and destination management organizations Responsibilities Teach undergraduate courses in tourism, hospitality, event management, sport tourism, or related domains. jobs.title: Assistant Professor - Accounting
jobs.description: Assistant/Associate Professor of Accounting Assistant/Associate Professor of Accounting Angola, Indiana (In-Person Instruction) Full-time Summary Trine University invites applications for a full-time Assistant/Associate Professor position in the Ketner School of Business beginning Fall 2026. The primary responsibility will be teaching undergraduate courses in accounting full-time on main campus in seated classes. Duties and Responsibilities Trine University is a teaching-focused institution. A standard teaching load for faculty is 12 credit hours per semester. Faculty are expected to spend 80% of their time on teaching, 10% on scholarship, and 10% on university service. Trine does not offer tenure. High-quality teaching is Trine University’s priority; however, faculty members are also expected to engage in professional development activities, develop/maintain appropriate professional contacts, and serve as academic advisors for students. Service, in the form of committee work, advising student organizations, etc. is highly valued. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of an MBA and be a CPA, but exceptionally qualified applicants with other areas of experience and expertise may be considered. The successful candidate will be able to teach undergraduate courses such as Accounting I & II, Personal Income Tax, Auditing, Accounting Information Systems, and be able to run an on-campus Volunteer Income Tax Assistance clinic (VITA). Expected teaching load is 12 hours per term. Duties will begin in August 2026. The successful candidate will be able to teach undergraduate courses, support accounting students through academic advising, and successfully direct and supervise internships. Other responsibilities will include playing an active role in recruiting and retention efforts and participating in Accounting Club activities. Duties will begin in August 2026. Qualifications The ideal candidate will have: Demonstrated education or experience that would support the teaching of specified accounting, finance, or business classes; A demonstrated record of excellence and innovation in teaching; A commitment to service as a faculty advisor, student organization advisor, and active member of an undergraduate teaching team; A strong network in the accounting industry and business connections. A minimum of 3 years of professional experience in a finance and/or accounting role; A strong understanding of and commitment to the Trine culture and to the Angola community. Candidates will be committed to working full-time on campus at Trine and serving students and the university in a variety of ways. Proficiency in accounting software is desired. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Required Education A terminal degree in Accounting or a closely related discipline is preferred; the minimum qualification for the position is a Master’s degree in Accounting or a closely related discipline. Candidates with at least a Master’s degree and extensive experience in finance or accounting will be strongly considered. A CPA designation is also preferred. Salary Rank and salary will be based on qualifications. Outstanding Benefits: Trine University offers a comprehensive benefit package designed to provide a variety of choices to best fit your needs and the needs of your family. Some benefits offered include: Health - medical, dental, flex spending, HSA accounts Life insurance - a variety of voluntary life options are available along with an employer paid employee life policy valued at 1 ½ times annual salary Paid vacation and sick time Retirement - after one year of full-time service you are eligible for an employer contribution of 5% and up to an additional 5% employer match Review of candidates will begin immediately and continue until the position is filled. Candidates should send a letter of interest, a curriculum vitae, detailing all academic & professional experience, plus the names, addresses, and telephone numbers of three references within their application.
